name: Puppet
description: Puppet Enterprise Orchestrator and Node Classifier workflows: job/task/plan orchestration and node group/classification management.

document.name: Run Puppet On Demand
document.description: Starts a Puppet agent deploy job against the nodes, query, or node group in scope.

a1a1.name: commandDeploy
a1a1.description: Starts a Puppet agent deploy job against the nodes, query, or node group in scope.

requestBody.description: JSON body with environment and scope (nodes/query/node_group); see the Orchestrator API README section for the shape

document.name: Run Task
document.description: Starts a task run job against the nodes, query, or node group in scope.

a1a1.name: commandTask
a1a1.description: Starts a task run job against the nodes, query, or node group in scope.

requestBody.description: JSON body with task, params, and scope

document.name: Run Plan
document.description: Starts a plan run job.

a1a1.name: commandPlanRun
a1a1.description: Starts a plan run job.

requestBody.description: JSON body with plan_name and params

document.name: Stop Job
document.description: Halts an in-progress deploy or task job.

a1a1.name: commandStop
a1a1.description: Halts an in-progress deploy or task job.

requestBody.description: JSON body with job (job ID) and optional force

document.name: Stop Plan
document.description: Halts an in-progress plan job.

a1a1.name: commandStopPlan
a1a1.description: Halts an in-progress plan job.

document.name: List Jobs
document.description: Returns a paginated list of jobs and their details.

a1a1.name: getJobs
a1a1.description: Returns a paginated list of jobs and their details.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return

minFinishTimestamp.description: Return jobs finished at or after this UTC timestamp

maxFinishTimestamp.description: Return jobs finished at or before this UTC timestamp

document.name: Get Job
document.description: Returns full details for a single job.

a1a1.name: getJobById
a1a1.description: Returns full details for a single job.

document.name: Get Job Events
document.description: Returns the per-node lifecycle events for a job.

a1a1.name: getJobEvents
a1a1.description: Returns the per-node lifecycle events for a job.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

document.name: Get Job Report
document.description: Returns the aggregate report for a finished job.

a1a1.name: getJobReport
a1a1.description: Returns the aggregate report for a finished job.

document.name: Get Job Nodes
document.description: Returns per-node state and result details for a job.

a1a1.name: getJobNodes
a1a1.description: Returns per-node state and result details for a job.

document.name: List Plans
document.description: Returns every plan known in the given environment.

a1a1.name: getPlans
a1a1.description: Returns every plan known in the given environment.

document.name: Get Plan
document.description: Returns metadata for a single plan.

a1a1.name: getPlanByName
a1a1.description: Returns metadata for a single plan.

module.description: Module name the plan belongs to

document.name: List Tasks
document.description: Returns every task installed in the given environment.

a1a1.name: getTasks
a1a1.description: Returns every task installed in the given environment.

document.name: Get Task
document.description: Returns metadata for a single task.

a1a1.name: getTaskByName
a1a1.description: Returns metadata for a single task.

module.description: Module name the task belongs to

document.name: Check Node Reachability
document.description: Checks whether the orchestrator's PCP broker can currently reach the given node.

a1a1.name: getInventoryNode
a1a1.description: Checks whether the orchestrator's PCP broker can currently reach the given node.

document.name: List Node Groups
document.description: Returns every node group in the classifier.

a1a1.name: getGroups
a1a1.description: Returns every node group in the classifier.

document.name: Create Node Group
document.description: Creates a new node group.

a1a1.name: createGroup
a1a1.description: Creates a new node group.

requestBody.description: JSON body with name, parent, classes, and optional rule/variables/environment

document.name: Get Node Group
document.description: Returns a single node group's definition.

a1a1.name: getGroupById
a1a1.description: Returns a single node group's definition.

document.name: Create Or Replace Node Group
document.description: Creates a node group at a specific UUID, or fully overwrites an existing group's definition.

a1a1.name: putGroup
a1a1.description: Creates a node group at a specific UUID, or fully overwrites an existing group's definition.

requestBody.description: JSON body with the full node group definition

document.name: Delete Node Group
document.description: Deletes a node group.

a1a1.name: deleteGroup
a1a1.description: Deletes a node group.

document.name: Get Node Group Children
document.description: Returns the node groups descending directly from the given parent group.

a1a1.name: getGroupChildren
a1a1.description: Returns the node groups descending directly from the given parent group.

document.name: List Classes
document.description: Returns every class known to the classifier, across all environments.

a1a1.name: getClasses
a1a1.description: Returns every class known to the classifier, across all environments.

document.name: Classify Node
document.description: Returns the classes, parameters, and environment a node would be assigned, given its facts.

a1a1.name: classifyNode
a1a1.description: Returns the classes, parameters, and environment a node would be assigned, given its facts.

requestBody.description: JSON body with fact/trusted/variable data for the node

document.name: List Environments
document.description: Returns known environments and per-environment class availability data.

a1a1.name: getEnvironments
a1a1.description: Returns known environments and per-environment class availability data.

document.name: List Node Check-Ins
document.description: Returns records of nodes that have checked into the classifier.

a1a1.name: getNodes
a1a1.description: Returns records of nodes that have checked into the classifier.
